item.title: Fundamentals of Acoustics: An Introductory Guide
item.author: huangxu2024@shanghaitech.edu.cn (Xu Huang)
item.description:
What is sound?
#

Sound is a mechanical disturbance propagating through an elastic medium. When a source vibrates, it compresses and expands adjacent medium particles periodically, forming alternating regions of compression and rarefaction that travel outward as longitudinal waves. Sound requires a medium — there is no sound propagation in vacuum.

item.title: FreeRTOS: A Practical Introduction to Real-Time Task Scheduling
item.author: huangxu2024@shanghaitech.edu.cn (Xu Huang)
item.description:
What is FreeRTOS?
#

FreeRTOS is a free, open-source real-time operating system kernel designed for microcontrollers and small microprocessors. It manages multiple tasks on a single CPU, deciding which task runs, when it runs, and for how long. The core is small — typically a few hundred lines of C plus architecture-specific assembly — and it runs directly on the hardware without an MMU.
